t2.thesis: Despite rapid optical AI DSP revenue growth, a demanding multi-quarter valuation re-rating (+330% 12-month run) and recent sector cooling across optical peers leave MaxLinear vulnerable to post-earnings profit-taking even on solid prints.
reasons: Semiconductors have a sub-50% base rate (0.479) for overnight earnings gains.
In Q2, MXL beat consensus and guided Q3 revenue up 27% sequentially, yet the stock still opened down -3.68%, showing high expectations are already priced in.
Broader AI connectivity peers (e.g., Credo, Astera Labs) and chipmakers experienced recent volatility and multiple contraction ahead of late October.
The current quarter EPS estimate ($0.56) represents a near 300% YoY growth hurdle, leaving little margin for error on Q4 guidance.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 2026 revenue guidance and optical AI DSP (Keystone/800G) trajectory relative to high expectations.

prior.from: registry base rate for the semiconductors ('semis') cluster (n=434, t0_hit=0.479)

t2.moved_from_prior: Started from the semiconductor cluster base rate of 0.479. Pulled slightly down to 0.47 given tough guidance comps and the prior quarter's negative reaction to a beat-and-raise, partially cushioned by a recent pullback from 52-week highs.

theses.expected: Q4 guidance meets but does not meaningfully exceed elevated whisper numbers; stock drifts lower on sell-the-news.
theses.mechanism: High multiples (P/S >12x) and massive 12-month gains require aggressive guide-ups to sustain upside momentum.
theses.wrong_if: Management guides Q4 far above the implied run-rate driven by accelerated 800G/1.6T hyperscaler design wins.

theses.expected: Core broadband/gateway recovery lags while AI infrastructure carrying the entire quarter leads to mixed margin delivery.
theses.mechanism: Negative GAAP operating margins and high R&D/opex dilute non-GAAP upside surprises.
theses.wrong_if: Topaz and Puma 9 carrier traction accelerates gross margin expansion above 61%.

theses.expected: Relief bounce after recent 28%+ pullback from October highs.
theses.mechanism: Short covering (7.5% float short) and options de-volatility fuel a morning bid if revenue hits high end of $210-220M range.
theses.wrong_if: Broad chip market weakness and cautious enterprise spending guidance trigger another post-print gap down.

key_observations: Q3 reported net revenue vs guided range ($210M-$220M)
Q4 net revenue and non-GAAP gross margin outlook
Keystone 800G optical PAM4 DSP volume commentary and 1.6T customer pipeline milestones
Progress on broadband/PON gateway products (Puma 9 and Topaz)
